market_view: Pre-market 6:40 ET Tuesday: futures give back part of Monday's surge (S&P +4.7%, Nasdaq 100 +7.0%, best day since 2025 on Jensen Huang's return to Nvidia). SPY ~715.6 (-0.9%), QQQ ~639.6 (-1.8%), IWM 264.4; NVDA ~156.4 (-5.2% after +31.5%), SMH -3.9% pre, KLAC 139 (-4.7%), DELL 316 (-5.6%, reports tonight). VIX 29, 10-year 4.92%, WTI US$80.06, gold US$3,630, BTC US$59,790 with Fear & Greed 11. SPY is still under its 20-day (745.7). The desk treats Monday as a relief gap until it holds.

Four trades max, the 1R half banked at once with VIX at 29.
